Infrastructure revenue declined 7% this quarter.
In infrastructure, our revenue grew 12% this quarter, with hybrid infrastructure up 25% and infrastructure support down 6%.
Our backlog yields are up 4 points year-over-year, talking about the quality and value we're able to deliver.
About $30 billion-plus trailing 12 months. 80% of that is high-value annuity-based business.
